svg.text: Site Safety Abnormality Detection and Follow-Up
The Human Project Manager's Cognitive and Procedural Workflow — the tacit reasoning a Cognitive Digital Twin must replicate at the "Contextualise" stage
Context: large public hospital project, Hong Kong Hospital Authority contract, Pay for Safety Scheme (PFSS)
The internal sequence of questions an experienced PM asks — largely undocumented in any procedure
has this recurred on this project?
Industrial Undertakings Ordinance · approved method statement
does this also imply a QUALITY defect or rework?
does it affect PROGRAMME or following trades?
does it affect PFSS payment or contractual position?
The PM integrates element identity, causation, exposure, hazard,
severity, recurrence and regulation into a single coherent judgement.
This integrative step is what current Digital Twins cannot perform.
structured data asset for the Digital Twin
toolbox talk · safety alert · lessons-learned register
No — escalation loop: re-issue, escalate severity, notify higher authority
rarely closed in practice — the missing cross-phase loop
What a Digital Twin currently CAN do

g.text: • Detect objects and geometry from images and point clouds
• Synchronise real-time sensor state and location data
• Flag rule-based deviations (PPE absent, zone intrusion)
• Log, timestamp and visualise recorded events
• Infer WHY the condition arose — design, sequencing or workmanship
• Judge severity against project-specific tolerance and experience ⚠
• Recognise recurrence patterns across trades and time ⚠
• Integrate safety, quality, programme and contractual consequence ⚠

svg.text: Lane 3 constitutes the Contextualise stage of the proposed Cognitive Digital Twin; each ⚠ marks a tacit judgement that the twin must learn to replicate.
